orientation.note_en: Room 3.0 x 2.7 m. The inward-opening door is at the west end of the north (top) wall; the single sash window with the table is centred in the south (bottom) wall; the narrow fireplace is centred in the east (right) wall; the looking-glass and washstand are on the west (left) wall. Camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks.

landmarks.name: rag rug
landmarks.name_en: the rag rug in the middle of the floor

landmarks.name_en: the little table in the window
